description: This file defines an entry point for a plugin called 'diagnostics-otel', primarily registering a diagnostics service that exports events to OpenTelemetry.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the diagnostics OpenTelemetry service with the provided API.

methods.name: definePluginEntry
methods.description: Imports and uses a helper to define a plugin entry with plugin metadata and registration logic.

methods.name: createDiagnosticsOtelService
methods.description: Creates and returns the diagnostics OpenTelemetry service to be registered.
